targeted_pool: gate_proj + up_proj + down_proj across all 30 decoder layers
depth_conditioning: FP16 FiLM scale_in[576] + scale_mid[1536] + scale_out[576] per logical layer

training.loss: mean of site-normalized per-logical-layer output MSE

packed_representation: Q4_GROUP64 physical MLP matrices + FP16 layer FiLM scales
baseline: independent Q4_GROUP64 gate/up/down matrices for all 30 logical MLPs

component_gate.pass: MLP-pool reduction >=8x; packed median site NMSE <=0.05; packed p90 <=0.15; worst physical-group median <=0.10
component_gate.borderline: MLP-pool reduction >=7x; packed median <=0.10; packed p90 <=0.25; worst physical-group median <=0.15
component_gate.aggregation: site-normalized per-logical-layer NMSE only; no raw cross-site output-energy weighting

claim_boundary: Real-pretrained MLP component diagnostic only. No attention, end-to-end PPL, native runtime, RSS, VRAM, or whole-model compression claim.
